title: Ring fill with a climbing percentage
summary: One thin ring on a flat saturated field fills clockwise from 12 o'clock while the centred percentage counts up in sync, fast through the middle and crawling into the last points. A single stat lands without any other element.
use_when: One headline figure (accuracy, uptime, completion) needs its own short beat
A loading or processing moment inside a longer product film
A loopable social tile or stat card for a feed
Silent autoplay where the number must read without VO

look.type_style: bold grotesk numerals with a percent sign, centred in the ring, cap height about 7 % of frame height; label width grows with digit count

sfx.event: counter digits change during the fast middle of the fill
ring closes at the final value

structure.shot: one thin ring centred on a flat bright field: pale track, dark progress arc filling clockwise from 12 o'clock, percentage label in the centre
structure.motion: fill and counter share one curve: holds at 0 until about f8 (±0.25 s), short ease-in, fastest 1.00 to 1.27 s (22 to 51 %), then a long decelerating tail close to easings.outExpo, 85 % at f60, 95 % at f83, 99 % from f105 to the end; label is an integer that tracks the arc each frame; nothing enters or exits

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the field, fg for arc and label, a 30 % tint of fg or a lighter bg tone for the track
params.content.value: final value 0..1 (reference stops just short of full, label reads 99)
params.content.suffix: unit after the number, default percent sign
params.content.caption: optional short label under the ring, off in the reference
params.timing.duration: frames of the fill (default 105, then hold to the end)
params.ring.stroke: stroke px at 1080 short side (default 12, thin)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Counter values read from sheet-01 (t s: %): 0.27:0, 0.50:2, 0.77:9, 1.00:22, 1.27:51, 1.50:68, 1.77:78, 2.00:85, 2.27:90, 2.50:93, 2.77:95, 3.00:97, 3.27:98, 3.50:99, 3.77:99. Arc and number move together; the arc starts at 12 o'clock and runs clockwise with butt caps. ProgressRing defaults differ (9 o'clock, counter-clockwise, thick stroke, glow, inOutExpo): set startAngle 0, direction 1, a thin stroke, glow 0 and a decelerating easing. Not loopable as is (ends at 99 %, starts at 0 %). Proposed term progress-ring (circular fill tied to a counter) not in vocabulary. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
